description: Snowmobile trails with a warming hut, maintained by the Nelson Sno - Goers. Lots of opportunities for sledding in the open cut blocks in the area. For a trail map, see PDF at bottom of page.
directions: From the 4 way stop at the end of Baker Street in Nelson, head North on Highway 6 for approximately 7 KM. Turn off on the Give out Creek FSR on the right hand side. The parking area is the start of the snowmobile trail network.
title: Giveout Creek Snowmobile Trail
